subject: ERROR after deploying an app with "string multibyte"

messages.author: 39bd9faf91c5aa55
messages.subject: ERROR after deploying an app with "string multibyte"
parts:
Hi,
After deploying an application that works locally perfectly well I get this error:

ERROR: string multibyte 1 invÃ¡lida

The app is: https://goerlich.shinyapps.io/census/, and read a csv table with two variables that contain non-plain ASCII characters (like á or ñ).
I can see that (almost sure) this is the problem, but I cannot test it because in my machine I don´t get the error.
Does any one knows a solution?

Thanks a lot?

messages.author: cc1ef8c8158d6b73
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] ERROR after deploying an app with "string multibyte"
parts:
Please read the article http://shiny.rstudio.com/articles/unicode.html
(in particular, the section "File Input/Output") It looks like you
have to specify the fileEncoding argument of read.csv().

Regards,
Yihui

messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] ERROR after deploying an app with "string multibyte"
parts:
Many thanks Yihui,

As sugested, I solved it using the "fileEncoding="ISO8859-1" (Windows default) in the read.table()

Regrads,
